facts.fact: Depeches241 reports that Vectis, an Involys system used by Gabon since 2012, runs the state's whole budget process from preparation to spending commitment.
Depeches241 reports that Gabon's first national data centre, run by ST Digital, was inaugurated at Nkok on 3 July 2026 to host data of the state, companies and citizens.
Depeches241 reports that President Oligui Nguema presented the Nkok national data centre, inaugurated 3 July 2026, as aimed at bringing hosting of strategic state data back to Gabon.
